_comment: Pinned rclone release used for the bundled binary. Artifact keys use Node's/electron-builder's arch naming (x64, arm64), not rclone's own uname-style release filenames — keep in sync with binaryResolver.ts and electron-builder.yml's ${arch} macro. Bumped from 1.69.0 to 1.74.4: v1.69.0 used the iclouddrive backend's plaintext /appleauth/auth/signin flow, which Apple has since blocked, making every login fail with HTTP 400 'Invalid Session Token' (rclone#8155, rclone#8587) regardless of correct credentials. rclone PR #9209/#9234 (merged into v1.74.0) replaced this with SRP authentication, matching what the iCloud web UI itself uses. Bumped again from 1.74.4 to 1.75.1: since mid-2026 Apple's POST /verify/trusteddevice/securitycode and /verify/phone/securitycode return HTTP 409 even for a VALID code; 1.74.4 treated that as failure ("validate2FACode failed: HTTP error 409", and a follow-up 'sms' then failed with "getAuthState: HTTP error 409"). Fixed upstream in rclone commit 731f2a6c2 (rclone#9488), first released in v1.75.0. The rc config continuation protocol is unchanged between 1.74.4 and 1.75.1. sha256 values verified against https://github.com/rclone/rclone/releases/download/v1.75.1/SHA256SUMS. Update deliberately, not automatically, and re-verify the 2FA continuation flow against any new version before bumping.
